captions.detailed: A 3D printable pencil topper or connector shaped as a tall, extruded triangular prism with rounded corners. It features a central cylindrical hole running through its entire length to slide onto a pencil or rod. The outer three flat faces of the triangular prism are designed to accommodate customizable embossed text.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric pencil topper in OpenSCAD shaped as a triangular prism with rounded corners and a central cylindrical hole. Provide adjustable parameters for the pencil diameter, wall thickness, corner radius, total length, and three customizable text messages to be embossed on each of the flat outer faces.
captions.factory: The script uses 'linear_extrude' to create the main 3D body from a 2D profile. The 2D profile is constructed using a 'difference' operator that subtracts a central 'circle' (representing the pencil hole) and three custom 'roundcorner' shapes (using 'polygon' and 'circle' subtraction) from a main 'triangle' module. Parametric text is projected onto the three flat faces of the extruded prism using the 'write' library, rotated by 120-degree increments and translated outward from the center.
